description: This file implements the WebAudioPlayerServerInternal class and related factory functions for managing Web Audio playback, including shared memory buffer management, GStreamer integration, and thread-safe operations within the Rialto server environment.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerServerInternal
classes.description: Implements the internal server-side logic for Web Audio playback, including buffer management, thread synchronization, and interaction with GStreamer.

methods.name: initWebAudioPlayerInternal
methods.description: Initializes shared memory buffers and GStreamer player for Web Audio playback.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback via the GStreamer player.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback via the GStreamer player.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Sets end-of-stream condition, either immediately or after queued frames are processed.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves available buffer information and frames for writing.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Calculates and returns the current buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio frames to shared memory and GStreamer pipeline.

methods.name: writeBufferInternal
methods.description: Handles the internal logic of writing frames to shared memory and GStreamer.

methods.name: writeStoredBuffers
methods.description: Writes any stored buffers that haven't yet been sent to GStreamer.

methods.name: updateAvailableBuffer
methods.description: Updates the available buffer state after data has been written.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Provides device capabilities such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the client interface.

methods.name: notifyState
methods.description: Notifies the client of a change in playback state.

methods.name: initGstWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Initializes the GStreamer Web Audio player with specified capabilities.

methods.name: handleWriteDataTimer
methods.description: Handles periodic timer events to write buffered data to GStreamer.

methods.name: getQueuedFramesInShm
methods.description: Calculates the number of queued frames in shared memory.
